item.violation_key: stable key emitted by the checker

semantics.excepted: violation matched by an active exception; verdict=excepted, passed=false, blocks_acceptance=false
semantics.unused_exception: active exception whose violation_key matched no current violation; removable and reported, never silently dropped
semantics.inactive_exception: exception not yet in force (introduced_revision > current) or expired (expires_revision < current); reported separately so it cannot be mistaken for an exception
semantics.expiry_boundary: expires_revision is the last architecture revision at which the exception is active (inclusive)
semantics.scope_ids: audit metadata only; matching is by exact violation_key. scope_ids do not widen or narrow an exception
semantics.violation_key_stability: keys use qualified names and declared component ids, never content-derived entity ids; custom_contract keys include the assertion and parameters.limit
semantics.exception_changes: added/removed/changed against the previous architecture revision; changed compares id, introduced_revision, reason, scope_ids, expires_revision and source
